1 (Currently Amended): A method of analyzing one or more plant embryos comprising: (a) collecting shed cellular material from one or more embryos by agitating __the__ one or more embryos in a non-destructive medium; (b) obtaining DNA from the shed cellular material; (c) performing a molecular analysis of the DNA obtained in step (b); and (d) germinating at least one of said one or more embryos, wherein the __shed cellular material comprises cellular components that retain viability__.

7 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein DNA is obtained by incubating the shed cellular material with an enzyme, wherein the enzyme is __selected from a group consisting of VISCOZYME@ and a cell wall degrading enzyme that does not harm the viability of embryos__.

11 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the one or more embryos comprise one or more immature embryos, wherein said immature embryos are __selected based on their ability to maintain viability during the analysis__.

12 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising storing the one or more embryos in __a quiescent state__ prior to step (c) or (d).

13 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1, wherein said molecular analysis is genotyping, __which is performed using PCR techniques to analyze genetic markers__.

17 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 further comprising selecting one or more embryos based on genotype, wherein __the selection process includes comparing genetic markers obtained from molecular analysis__. 

18 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 17 further comprising germinating the one or more selected embryos __that exhibit desired traits based on the genotype analysis__. 

19 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 18 wherein any of the steps resulting in selection of one or more embryos __and germination is performed using automation techniques__.
